author: ClaymanMMI
body:
Hi, my account got banned in January and I got innocent banned for "kill aura". I've been waiting a long time now and i would be glad to join again. I have not done anything bad and especially not hack (I don't even know how to download hacks). I got banned because i killed some other players (2) and I was on a streak (Watch my profile) and then they started raising up against me and accusing me for hacking, but I don't hack. Suddenly I got banned by MidnightBeast for kill aura.

*My username is ClaymanMMI (former McChicken01)

*I was banned because I was innocent accused for using kill aura. Reason why? People rasied up against me because I played good and then more players that didn't know anything about it.

*I Think I should get unbanned because I have not done anything wrong. I have been banned for a long time now and I really want to take part of keeping the server going. I want a new chance to prove that I'm not using hacks. My most recent playing is shown at my profile and I can prove that I do not use hacks because I got killed. The reason why I was on streak was because I played with a friend and I played defensive with armour.

title: Temp. ban

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Hello,

In order to submit a proper appeal, please use the following steps:
  • Your minecraft username 
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned
  • Why you should be unbanned
Make your appeal as detailed as possible. Good luck!

Welcome back to Avicus.

Regards,
LegendaryEngram,
